question: Is the split year-end bonus arrangement for Veldhoven Foods still active for this December's payroll?

transcript.text: Hi, it's Marc from Veldhoven Foods. Your predecessor agreed we'd pay the year-end bonus in two parts, November and December. Is that still set up for this year? I need to tell our works council by Friday.
I took over your file recently. Let me check what was agreed and come back to you.

searchSteps: Searching the client file, handover notes and emails…
Reading workflow tickets and payroll configuration
Building a timeline of the arrangement
groupsTitle: Search results — timeline of the arrangement

groups.headline: Split bonus agreed
groups.evidenceNote: Handover document by Lotte, the previous consultant.
groups.assessment: Owned, but written before later changes

extracts.title: Client handover — Veldhoven Foods
extracts.excerpt: Special arrangement: the year-end bonus is paid in two instalments (50% in the November run, 50% in December), agreed with the client and the works council. Configured as BONUS_EOY_A / BONUS_EOY_B.

flags.text: Written in 2022; not updated after the 2024–2025 changes

groups.headline: Client asked to revert
groups.evidenceNote: Email thread between Veldhoven HR and Lotte.
groups.assessment: Shows intent, but no decision recorded

extracts.title: Email: Bonus payment 2024 — single payment?
extracts.excerpt: Client (HR): “We would like to go back to a single December payment from next year, to be confirmed after the works council meeting.” Reply: “Noted, we will check with you in Q1 and adapt the configuration.”

flags.text: Works council confirmation is not in the thread

groups.evidenceNote: ServiceNow change ticket closed by Youssef.

extracts.excerpt: Merged BONUS_EOY_A and BONUS_EOY_B into BONUS_EOY (100% in December run) on request of the account team. Client approval: “see email”. No attachment.

flags.text: Refers to an approval email that isn't attached

groups.headline: Current config: one December payment
groups.assessment: Most current source; shows what will happen, not what was agreed

extracts.title: Payroll configuration — Veldhoven Foods (live)
extracts.excerpt: BONUS_EOY — 100% — paid in the December run. BONUS_EOY_A / _B: inactive since 01/04/2025.

flags.text: Live system data, refreshed 2 days ago

signals.text: The handover (E1) says split payment; the live configuration (E4) says a single December payment.
Neither a client or works council approval of the change nor the “see email” from ticket E3 was found.
The handover document was never updated after the 2025 change.

answer.verdict: Probably no longer active — confirm before replying
answer.text: The live configuration shows the year-end bonus as a single December payment, and a 2025 change ticket confirms the split was removed. The client itself asked to revert in 2024. However, no document records the formal client or works council approval, and the handover document still describes the old split arrangement.
answer.indicative: Likely answer: a single payment in December 2026, unless the client never formally approved the change.

keyPoints.text: Live system data (Sept 2026) shows a single December payment.
Timeline is consistent: client request (2024), then change implemented (2025).
The client's approval email referenced in the ticket is missing.
The handover document is outdated and would mislead the next consultant.

answer.gap: Confirm that Veldhoven Foods formally approved ending the split bonus in 2025, then update the handover document before replying to Marc.
